verdict.rationale: Viam's open-source RDK (viam-server) runs on the user's own compute device and can be started from source against a local JSON config, so the on-machine runtime is self-hostable. The cloud platform is a different matter: fleet management, data sync, ML training, OTA updates and hosted apps are all described as Viam-hosted cloud services. A community user's question about running the server on their own cloud goes unanswered in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting of the cloud control plane (app, fleet management, data management), official self-host or on-prem deployment docs, independent confirmation of fully offline or self-hosted operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
